title: Module 5 Current — vs. Peer Band (Modules 1–4,6–8 Avg ± 2σ)

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "machine_metrics" and
    r.machine == "2406-176021" and
    r._field == "Module5_Current_A"
  )
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

union(tables: [from(bucket: v.bucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "machine_metrics" and r.machine == "2406-176021" and r._field == "Module1_Current_A") |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])]) |> group(columns: ["_time"]) |> mean(column: "_value")

import "math"

union(tables: [from(bucket: v.bucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "machine_metrics" and r.machine == "2406-176021" and r._field == "Module1_Current_A") |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])]) |> group(columns: ["_time"]) |> reduce(identity: {t: time(v: 0), count: 0, sum: 0.0, sumSq: 0.0}, fn: (r, accumulator) => ({t: r._time, count: accumulator.count + 1, sum: accumulator.sum + r._value, sumSq: accumulator.sumSq + r._value * r._value})) |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r.t, _value: 0.0}))
